h1: Powering Maldivian Enterprises with Cloud AI Agents
sub: Equip your island operations with autonomous AI bots running 24/7 on private cloud computers, handling browser research, resort operations, and code around the clock.
audience: Resort operations managers, logistics coordinators across atolls, guesthouse entrepreneurs in local islands, Malé trading houses, and remote developers.
manifesto: Spanning twenty-six natural atolls, Maldivian commerce never sleeps. Ceyo gives your business dedicated cloud computers that manage resort logistics, monitor supply transfers, and code solutions while you navigate island life effortlessly.

uses.d: Deploy Telegram-integrated bots to answer multilingual traveler requests, track booking statuses, and update CRM records automatically.
Monitor inter-island cargo runs, supplier price sheets in Malé, and ferry schedules through automated browser checks and sheet syncs.
Instruct agents to scrape and compare room tariffs across regional OTAs daily, delivering concise pricing intelligence to your team.
Automate the gathering of shipping manifests, vendor invoices, and customs paperwork into structured cloud folders with zero manual entry.
Collect water temperature readings, survey spreadsheets, and research papers autonomously, compiling formatted weekly briefs for conservationists.
Let your coding agent build internal booking utilities, run test suites, and deploy production-ready web tools right inside its virtual machine.

steps.d: Select your bot's core skills and start an isolated cloud machine in under a minute.
Link your Telegram, Google Sheets, calendars, and enterprise tools for autonomous coordination.
Schedule routines and let your bot execute continuous research, coding, and reporting 24/7.

chapters.d: Your agent checks island supply boat logistics and fuel quotes across Malé harbor, pinging your team with a complete summary before breakfast.
Multiple specialist bots coordinate guest sea-plane arrivals, update front-desk calendars, and adjust villa preparation times seamlessly.
The autonomous browser scans live hospitality aggregators across Baa and Ari atolls, noting competitor rate adjustments in a shared spreadsheet.
While your phone is powered down, the cloud bot tests codebase updates, backs up reservation databases, and logs financial tallies.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a payment card is connected upfront and charged only after the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Which languages can my Ceyo agents understand?
faq.a: Your bots understand and generate fluent English, handle Dhivehi text queries, and communicate in dozens of international languages to assist global tourists and suppliers.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots stop working if my island internet drops?
faq.a: No. Every Ceyo agent runs on its own isolated 24/7 cloud computer, continuing web tasks, scheduled routines, and data processing even if your local connection drops or phone is off.

faq.q: Can I manage my bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact directly with your bots via private Telegram messages or add several bot specialists to team group chats so they can collaborate on complex workflows.

faq.q: How are my company files and credentials secured?
faq.a: Each agent operates inside a sandboxed virtual machine with segregated storage, ensuring your credentials, uploaded documents, and crypto wallet operations remain fully isolated.
